assessment: The authors found that NMNAT binds to p53 and that p53 is post-translationally regulated to control apoptosis in glioma models. Work found that depletion of NMNAT1 and NMNAT2 inhibits and that overexpression of the enzymes promotes glioma growth. Furthermore, depletion of NMNAT1/2 increases apoptosis and overexpression of the enzymes inhibits apoptosis upon cisplatin treatment. This is an exciting mechanism that extends NAD biology, p53 regulation, and the field of glioma pathogenesis.
